prompt: A photo-mode capture from a video game that draws its world and its people in two different ways. Every building, street, lamp and sky is coarse chunky pixel art: big square pixels, sixteen colours, hard pixel edges. Only the people are painted in muted realism: weathered faces with real skin texture, stubble and tired eyes, 1930s wool coats, flat caps and worn leather. Evening: a low amber sun from the right through drifting dust and chimney smoke, long hard shadows. A tall narrow building cut open like a doll's house, seen from across the street, low and to the left, four floors from the top down: a cold blue attic where an old woman in a coat shivers by one candle; a brick red bakery where a crowd in red scarves and a crowd in blue scarves, mixed ages and skin tones, shove each other; an emerald-lit basement where printing presses throw banknotes while gangsters in pinstripe suits play music and a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat and gold chain dances; an orange furnace at the bottom. A police car roof in the near left corner. Thanks.
